name: Side-by-Side performance with the Lansing Symphony Orchestra
what_you_do: Audition. Then practice with a mentor and play with the pro orchestra at a holiday pops show at the Wharton Center.
who_can_apply: High school instrumentalists. The page does not list grades or ages.
duration: Rehearsals and one concert in December
deadline_text: Application is due Friday, Nov 6, 2026 at 5 p.m. Auditions are Nov 12, 2026. The concert is Dec 13, 2026 at the Wharton Center.
how_to_apply: Send the Side By Side Audition form from the page. Questions: Ashleigh Lore, ashleigh@lansingsymphony.org.
